archetypes.name: dyn-invariant-parser
archetypes.rationale: Parser boundary and verbatim-body behavior are the core risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the invariant parser changes for Markdown heading boundaries, adjacent I-* entries, blank-line trimming, and verbatim body retention. Check that guideline parsing behavior stayed unchanged except for documentation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
